title: View a GitHub issue in the web browser
summary: Open a specific issue in your default web browser using its number or URL. This is useful for viewing details or comments that are easier to read in the browser.
prerequisites: You are logged in to GitHub with gh auth login

steps.explain: Open the specified issue in your default web browser.

placeholders.name: ISSUE_NUMBER_OR_URL
placeholders.description: The issue number (e.g., 123) or the full URL of the issue
